name: Wolf of White Waters
source:
Wolf of White Waters is a short and linear furry visual novel that follows an imprisoned Prince on the shores of a foreign land. What mysteries will he see on that horizon?

IT TASTES SALTIER THAN HE'D IMAGINED.

The sea. So deep and dark and blue. The saltwater taints him. It's in the air. With every breath he tastes it. Hot and muggy.

The Prince thinks of the mountains. The great white peaks. Large stone arches and heroes and heroines hewn of stone. He'd wanted to be like them. Things were easier then, when he was little. 

His tutor laughed at the idea. It was a charming laugh. Then she smiled and nodded her head. She used to bake the most delicious sweat buns he'd ever tasted. Sometimes he'd sneak a second before dinner. Sometimes a third.

Her face. He can't remember what she looked like now. He likes it that way.

[From [url=https://kraajlanding.itch.io/wolf-of-white-waters]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《白水之狼》是一部简短而线性的毛茸茸视觉小说，讲述了一位被囚禁在异国海岸的王子的故事。他会在那地平线上看到什么谜团？

它的味道比他想象的还要咸。

海。如此深邃、黑暗、蓝色。盐水污染了他。它在空气中。他每次呼吸都尝到了它的味道。又热又闷。

王子想到了山。伟大的白色山峰。巨大的石拱门和用石头凿成的英雄和女英雄。他想成为像他们一样的人。当他还小的时候，事情就容易多了。

他的导师嘲笑这个想法。那是一种迷人的笑声。然后她微笑着点点头。她曾经烤过他吃过的最美味的汗包。有时他会在晚饭前偷偷溜一会儿。有时是第三个。

她的脸。他已经不记得她现在长什么样了。他喜欢这样。

[来自[url=https://kraajlanding.itch.io/wolf-of-white-waters]Itch.io[/url]]
